peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (7.4): 0.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 27 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Context, not scored: resales in 12.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Marymount MRT about 300 m, Bishan MRT about 820 m; closer than 509 of 662 similar developments (the same as 6). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Marymount Convent School about 1,190 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 540 m), more than 132 of 662 similar developments (the same as 18); nearest hawker centre Shunfu Mart about 440 m; nearest park Macritchie Reservoir Park about 630 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Artisan 8, 4 new sales, about 600 m; The Orie, 25 new sales, about 1,630 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 34 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 29 new sales and 348 resales (377 purchases); new sales were 7.7% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Thomson Reserve development, about 1,310 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 348 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 68 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 348 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 430 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19.1%). Planning-area private resales −23.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
